scope: Read-only teacher requery on saved rejected TRAIN pilot states. No new rollout or fit.
interpretation: Pair gaps establish target sensitivity at fixed observations, not the empirical Bayes error of the original dataset. Half the absolute pair gap is the minimum possible pair-mean absolute error if both labels are attached to the same input with equal weight.
